title: Koudou Saisoku Densetsu: Initial D
native_title: 公道最速伝説 頭文字Ｄ
overview: Koudou Saisoku Densetsu: Initial D is a downhill drift racing game based on the Initial D manga and anime franchise. The main scenario mode recreates a series of races from the original manga; defeating a rival in this mode will unlock their car for use in other modes. There is also a battle mode where the player can choose any of the four courses, plus a car and a rival, and race against the computer. There is also a time attack mode which lets the player save ghost replays of their best times, and a specialized drift practice mode.
